Summary Collaboration Themes: The collaboration between John Jiang and Kimball Martin represents a unique fusion of applied nonlinear dynamics and pure arithmetic geometry. By applying data-driven machine learning techniques like SINDy and Koopman operator theory to the structural and statistical properties of modular forms and algebraic curves, they can develop new computational tools for number theory. Conversely, the rigorous algebraic structures and symmetry principles from arithmetic geometry can inform the development of more robust and interpretable models for complex dynamical systems in power grids. This synergy bridges the gap between empirical data analysis and deep theoretical mathematics, leading to advancements in both algorithmic efficiency and theoretical understanding.
